description: Drinking Water Access Deprivation Modelled Dataset in Kano, Nigeria is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Produced as part of the IDEAMAPS Data Ecosystem project, this dataset maps relative levels of difficulty in accessing safe and reliable drinking water across urban areas. It provides a spatial representation of access constraints by combining physical accessibility, service reliability, and demand pressures at the neighbourhood level. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Drinking Water, Accessibility, Kano. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
